title: Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2608.23098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classical Chinese poetry composition has long valued Tuiqiao, the iterative refinement of words, imagery, and prosody. However, many current AI poetry systems follow a one-shot generation paradigm, which reduces users to prompt providers and weakens their creative agency. We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition. The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. translated_title: 九歌·推敲：一种可解释的人机协作系统用于古典诗词润色
translated_abstract: 古典诗词创作历来重视“推敲”，即对词语、意象和音律的反复打磨。然而，当前许多AI诗歌系统采用一次性生成模式，将用户降级为提示提供者，削弱了他们的创作主动性。我们提出了九歌·推敲，一个用于古典诗词创作的交互式人机协作系统。该系统围绕三元模型设计：用户驱动控制、古籍引导证据和AI辅助生成。用户可以锁定字词或诗句，获得实时音律反馈，并得到基于高频搭配、按困惑度排序的经典诗句以及从类书提取的结构化知识的可解释润色建议。这种设计将AI从自主生成器转变为背景助手，支持用户自身的诗歌润色过程。初步实验和用户反馈表明，该系统在增强用户创作参与感和提供有意义的润色建议方面具有潜力。
tldr: 该系统通过用户驱动控制、古籍证据和AI辅助生成的三元模型，将AI从自主生成器转变为背景助手，支持古典诗词的交互式可解释润色，增强用户的创作主动性。
en_tdlr: This system transforms AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant through a triadic model of user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation, enabling interactive interpretable refinement of classical poetry and enhancing user creative agency.
